name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise Dubois is a seasoned Head of Operations with nearly three decades of experience in motorsport. Born and raised in Geneva, her passion for racing ignited at a young age, fueled by frequent visits to local hill climb events. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from ETH Zurich, she began her career as a trackside engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to her meticulous attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure.

Throughout her career, Elise has worked with several prestigious racing teams, contributing to championship-winning campaigns in both Formula and Endurance racing. She is known for her data-driven approach to operations, combining rigorous analysis with a pragmatic mindset to optimize team performance. Elise's dedication to excellence and unwavering focus make her a highly sought-after leader, committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement within any organization. A perfectionist at heart, she believes that the smallest details can make the biggest difference on race day.

Elise's distinctive approach is characterized by her ability to blend traditional engineering principles with cutting-edge technologies. She's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and constantly seeks innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency. Her leadership style is collaborative and decisive, empowering her team to take ownership and contribute their best work.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled chin-length bob, often tucked behind her ears
physical.description: Elise is a slender woman of average height with a serious yet approachable demeanor.
